films.caption:
Chipotle, but make it bibimbap 🍚🇰🇷✨

Thanks @bibimgrill.usa for having me! 🧡 First time eating Korean bibimbap Chipotle style, and you get to build your bowl however you want 🙌

🍚 Carbs: white rice, purple rice, or japchae
🥩 Protein: chicken, beef, or shrimp
🍳 Top it off with a grill-fried egg. Yes, the yolk is runny 🤤

✨ Their chicken is halal friendly, and the steak is USDA Prime flat iron. That kind of quality at this price? Insane value 💸

❤️ My go-tos: spicy chicken and steak 🔥 And don’t skip the corn. Trust me, it’s a game changer 🌽

🎉 Good news: the soft opening BOGO 50% off just got extended to Nov 5th! Grab a buddy and go 👯‍♀️

📍 3742 Fallon Rd, Dublin, CA 94568

films.caption:
Korean comfort classics and authentic street food in Union City! This place has such a good variety of Korean dishes, it’s hard not to order everything.

My favorites were Jajang Myeon and Kimbap. They also have Korean Fried Chicken, but I actually preferred the Popcorn Chicken with soy garlic sauce.

Come with a group so you can share more dishes!

🥢
• Budae Jjigae
• K-Retro Pork Cutlet
• Jajang Myeon
• Rose Tteok Bok EE
• Soy Garlic Popcorn Chicken

@bibimgrill.usa 🥗 NEW FRESH & HEALTHY CONCEPT IN DUBLIN: BIBIMGRILL — KOREAN-STYLE CHIPOTLE! 🇰🇷✨🌶️🍚

Love a good customizable bowl? At Bibimgrill, you get to build your own bibimbap with your choice of base, protein, toppings and sauce! 😍

Here’s how it works in 4 easy steps:

1️⃣ Choose your base – Purple rice, white rice, japchae or mixed greens.

2️⃣ Pick your protein – Smoked garlic chicken, spicy chicken, bulgogi, steak or shrimp ceviche.

3️⃣ Add your toppings – Load up on fresh veggies and your favorite extras.

4️⃣ Finish with sauce – Bring your bowl together with a flavorful sauce and seasoning! 

🔥 SOFT OPENING SPECIAL: BOGO 50% OFF until October 31st!

📍 Already drawing a crowd in Dublin! If you love Chipotle-style bowls with a Korean twist, Bibimgrill is definitely worth checking out. 🤤
